title: CityPaint: A Free Lunch from 2D Diffusion for City-Scale 3D Texturing
abstract: arXiv:2610.27564v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating high-fidelity, city-scale 3D environments plays a crucial role in applications such as virtual reality, gaming, and urban digital twins. However, the scarcity of real-world city-scale 3D training data forces existing methods to either stitch independently generated assets or learn from synthetic urban corpora, often sacrificing realism and global consistency. In contrast, 2D image data and their corresponding generative models are abundant and encode rich visual priors. To bridge this gap, we propose CityPaint, a novel framework that leverages 2D diffusion models to generate globally consistent city-scale 3D textures without relying on city-scale 3D training data. Specifically, CityPaint integrates geometric priors with the generative power of 2D diffusion models, introducing a robust top-$K$ camera baking strategy for iterative texture projection. translated_title: CityPaint：来自2D扩散模型的城市级3D纹理生成免费午餐
translated_abstract: 生成高保真、城市尺度的3D环境在虚拟现实、游戏和城市数字孪生等应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，真实世界城市尺度3D训练数据的稀缺迫使现有方法要么拼接独立生成的资产，要么从合成的城市语料库中学习，这往往牺牲了真实感和全局一致性。相比之下，2D图像数据及其对应的生成模型则十分丰富，并编码了丰富的视觉先验。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了CityPaint，一个新颖的框架，它利用2D扩散模型生成全局一致的城市尺度3D纹理，而无需依赖城市尺度的3D训练数据。具体来说，CityPaint将几何先验与2D扩散模型的生成能力相结合，引入了一种鲁棒的top-K相机烘焙策略用于迭代纹理投影。为了解决2D到3D投影产生的伪影问题，我们进一步提出了一种解耦的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: CityPaint利用2D扩散模型丰富的视觉先验，通过几何先验融合与top-K相机烘焙策略，无需城市尺度3D训练数据即可生成全局一致的高保真城市级3D纹理。
en_tdlr: CityPaint leverages the rich visual priors of 2D diffusion models, combined with geometric priors and a robust top-K camera baking strategy, to generate globally consistent, high-fidelity city-scale 3D textures without requiring any city-scale 3D training data.
